note: Geometric check of the worker template's gestures (Avatar/Config/experiments_ab.md section 10, declared 2026-11-14 before any change or measurement; Nusrat). Read by Tools > Warehouse v4 > Experiments > Run Gesture Geometry Check (GestureGeometryDriver, Play mode). Every look of looks_ab.json avatar_experiment the worker template can spawn performs every clip of POINT, PROCEED, WAIT and STOP in worker_v4.json with both arms on a neutral stage; the rendered joints (UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand bones after the worker's LateUpdate) are compared with the worker's own goal of that frame. No perception model is run: an engineering check of the pose, not of what a camera reads.

tolerance.why: Declared in experiments_ab.md section 10 before any measurement. elbow_angle_deg: the rendered elbow's interior angle (shoulder-elbow-wrist) against the two-bone angle of the goal's shoulder-to-target distance with the rig's own upper arm and forearm. arm_direction_deg: shoulder-to-wrist against shoulder-to-target. forearm_direction_deg: elbow-to-wrist against vertical (WAIT) or against intended elbow-to-target (PROCEED). no_fold_min_elbow_deg: a straight-arm command (POINT 144 to 163 deg by design, worker_v4.json limits; STOP extended) whose elbow closes below 120 deg has folded. A look x command passes when every measured frame of every take passes all of them.

stage.why: A new unsaved scene: a grey floor, one directional light, flat ambient, no warehouse. One worker per look on its own spot spacing_m apart along x, a stand-in robot robot_distance_m in front (the asking distance), so each worker turns to face it. Variation stream SetRun(seed, take). hold_frames frames spread over the hold from settle_after_hold_s; PROCEED: every frame of proceed_window_s of the swing (the reader's window, gesture_reader.json proceed.window_s). POINT at the look check's side azimuths (0 = straight out to the person's own side, 45 = toward the front).

screens.why: Screenshots for Nusrat's visual check (section 10 item 8), NOT the robot cameras' settings and not perception input: a neutral camera distance_m in front of the worker, azimuth_right_deg toward its right, at height_m, aimed at aim_height_of_body x the look's height; one PNG per look of these kind groups (looks_ab.json kind_group), command and arm, in the middle of the hold (PROCEED: at the top of the swing).
